mapper.select: select i.inventory_id as inventoryId, i.prod_id as prodId, i.client_id as clientId, i.quantity as quantity, i.ware_id as wareId, i.last_inbound_date as lastInboundDate, i.last_outbound_date as lastOutboundDate, i.warehouse_pos_x as warehousePosX, i.warehouse_pos_y as warehousePosY, p.prod_name as prodName, p.prod_size as prodSize, p.prod_price as prodPrice from inventory i join product p on i.prod_id = p.prod_id where i.client_id = #{clientId}

select o.client_id as clientId, p.prod_name as prodName, o.quantity as quantity, o.req_outbound_date as reqOutboundDate, o.outbound_process_date as outboundProcessDate, o.ware_id as wareId, o.status as status from outbound o join product p ON o.prod_id = p.prod_id where o.client_id = #{clientId}

#{id}
